For purchases and downloads, the Google Play product identifier, the data needed to verify the purchase token and the user identifier may be linked to each other. Purchase entitlement is verified by the server; download entitlement is only granted after a verified purchase or a rewarded unlock for that specific version. The raw value of the purchase token is not stored in the app's database; only a non-reversible identifier needed for verification may be retained.
